name: utracer6
notes: Ronald Dekker's uTracer6 (1000 V / 1 A). Values checked against Dekker's uTracer6 construction log (Dekker, dos4ever.com/uTracerlog6/tubetester6.html, sections 7-10 and 14) on 2026-11-18, except where an entry says otherwise.

hv_divider_top_ohm.source: Dekker, dos4ever.com/uTracerlog6/tubetester6.html §8: R2 = 1M (R63/R83, HV chip resistors); V_HV = 1.0448 n

anode_sense_ohm.source: Dekker, dos4ever.com/uTracerlog6/tubetester6.html §10: default Rs = 4.7 ohm (user-changeable, entered on the cal form)

neg_divider_top_ohm.source: Dekker, dos4ever.com/uTracerlog6/tubetester6.html: schematic fig. 7.2 (uTracer6-V3) measures the -85 V rail through R27 200k / R29 4k7 into AN11; §9 "RB4/AN11 becomes ADC input to measure the -85 V output voltage"; §8 formula: -85 V gives n = 600. This is the rail the result string reports. (The -15 V rail, 47k/4k7 into AN5, is not in the result string.)

neg_rail_volts.source: Dekker, uTracer6 log, fig. 7.2 and §9: the -85 V supply (see the divider entry)

grid_dac_bits.source: Dekker, dos4ever.com/uTracerlog6/tubetester6.html §9: n = 32767 |Vg| / 100, bit 15 set for a positive grid

cathode_diode_drop_volts.source: Not in Dekker's uTracer6 formulas (V_tube = V_HV - V_supl). uTmax 3.01 still adds the uTracer3's 0.5 V.

hv_switch_drop_volts.source: Not in Dekker's uTracer6 formulas. uTmax 3.01 still subtracts the uTracer3 darlington's 0.75 V.
